CUTE PETS & WILDLIFE - FREE SAMPLE (CC0)
=========================================
3 rigged, animated animals (cat, fox, owl) from the full pack, 12 clips each, LOD0 + mobile LOD1 meshes in every file, GLB + FBX.
Public domain (CC0): use for anything, no attribution needed.  The full pack has 24 species in 45 files.

README_UPGRADE.txt.text:
Thanks for downloading the free Cute Pets sample (cat, fox and owl)! I hope it helps your project.
If you want more, the full pack has 36 rigged animals in 57 files with 12 animations each, plus 22 bonus props (GLB, FBX).
Full pack page: https://vuena.itch.io/blocky-pets-wildlife
No pressure at all: everything in this zip is CC0 and stays free forever, with or without the full pack.
See UPGRADE.png for a quick side-by-side. - Vuena (Popyca Studio)
